Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 Diagnostic Server instance and by the service processor itself. Therefore be- fore actually running the service processor, the service processor needs means to do a certain verification step. As the ara::diag::GenericUDSService has only one single method this is not possible for the ara::diag::GenericUDSService . As a result of this, the entire service specific ara::diag::GenericUDSService for UDS service TransferData (0x36).
